description: 《We Are Young》描寫青春歲月中的衝動、遺憾與渴望被理解的心情。歌中的主角在熱鬧的酒吧裡，試圖挽回一段因過去的錯誤而受傷的感情。他明白自己曾經傷害對方，也希望能彌補過錯，卻不知道兩人是否還有重新開始的機會。面對愛情的失落與生活的混亂，他與朋友舉杯狂歡，試圖在短暫的青春中尋找自由與慰藉。歌曲中的火焰與太陽象徵年輕時強烈的熱情，以及不願向現實低頭的勇氣。最終，《We Are Young》傳達的是青春中的迷惘、友情與珍惜當下：即使年輕時難免犯錯、受傷與失去方向，我們仍然渴望有人陪伴，在脆弱的時刻互相扶持，共同走過那些難忘的歲月。

vocabulary.meaning: 把事情的經過理清楚；想清楚要怎麼解釋
vocabulary.usage: 通常在說明一件複雜的事、接受詢問或澄清誤會前使用。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用這個詞語？
options: The train got my story straight and arrived at platform two.
Before the interview, I need a minute to get my story straight.
I bought three story straights at the bookshop yesterday.
Please get my story straight into the blue recycling bin.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：火車會到月台，但不會替人「理清說法」。
正確：面試前先整理好要說明的事情，符合片語意思。
錯誤：story straight 不是可以購買的書籍種類。
錯誤：此片語表示理清敘述，不是把故事當垃圾丟掉。
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：面試前先整理好要說明的事情，符合片語意思。

vocabulary.usage: 常用來描述微小的變化、暗示、氣味或差異。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用這個詞語？
options: The actor gave a subtle smile, and only the front row noticed it.
The fire alarm was so subtle that everyone ran outside at once.
Please subtle the door before the meeting starts.
Our bus arrived subtle at six o’clock.
optionExplanations: 正確：只有前排注意到的微笑可以形容為 subtle。
錯誤：讓所有人立刻衝出去的警報並非細微、不易察覺。
錯誤：subtle 是形容詞，不能直接當動詞使用。
錯誤：不能用形容詞 subtle 直接修飾動詞 arrived。
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：只有前排注意到的微笑可以形容為 subtle。

vocabulary.usage: 做錯事後承認錯誤、表達歉意時使用；常說 make an apology 或 offer an apology。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用這個詞語？
options: The weather forecast gave an apology of heavy rain tomorrow.
After breaking the museum sign, Leo offered a sincere apology.
We took the apology to the airport because our flight was late.
Mina was very apology when she missed the meeting.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：天氣預報會預測降雨，不會用 apology 表示預報。
正確：弄壞標示後真誠道歉，搭配與意思都自然。
錯誤：apology 是道歉，不是可搭乘的交通工具。
錯誤：apology 是名詞；這裡應用 sorry 或 apologetic。
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：弄壞標示後真誠道歉，搭配與意思都自然。

vocabulary.meaning: 收回剛說的話；撤回某個說法
vocabulary.usage: 當你發現自己說錯、誤會別人，或不想再堅持原來的話時使用。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用這個詞語？
options: The moon took it back because the sky was too crowded.
I take it back my old opinion about this film.
I said the new singer was terrible, but she was amazing. I take it back.
She took it back that she would tomorrow call.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：月亮不能收回先前的評論；句意不符合此片語。
錯誤：take it back 已含受詞 it，不能再直接加 my old opinion。
正確：改變評價並收回先前的話，正是 take it back 的用法。
錯誤：這裡的語序不自然；應說 she took back what she said。
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：改變評價並收回先前的話，正是 take it back 的用法。

vocabulary.meaning: 到……的時候（另一件事已經發生）
vocabulary.usage: 用來說明時間先後，常搭配過去完成式或未來完成式。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用這個詞語？
options: By the time we reached the station, the last train had left.
By the time is my favourite colour this year.
We bought two by the times for the school concert.
By the time of quickly, I opened the window.
optionExplanations: 正確：到達車站前，末班車就已離開，時間先後清楚。
錯誤：by the time 是時間連接語，不是顏色名稱。
錯誤：這個片語不能當可數物品來購買。
錯誤：by the time 後不能接 of quickly 這種不合文法的結構。
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：到達車站前，末班車就已離開，時間先後清楚。

vocabulary.meaning: 散架、破裂；（關係或計畫）瓦解
vocabulary.usage: 可形容物品壞掉，也能形容計畫、團隊或關係逐漸崩潰。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用這個詞語？
options: My sister fell apart the window to let in some air.
Our plan fell apart when the guide missed the boat.
The coach fell apart a new team last summer.
Please fall apart the lights before leaving the lab.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：fall apart 是不及物片語，不能這樣接 window 當受詞。
正確：嚮導沒搭上船導致計畫泡湯，可以說 fell apart。
錯誤：組成新隊伍應說 formed a team，不能用 fell apart。
錯誤：關燈應說 turn off the lights，fall apart 不表示關閉。
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：嚮導沒搭上船導致計畫泡湯，可以說 fell apart。

vocabulary.usage: 在婚禮、聚會、慶祝成功等場合，舉杯為人或事祝賀。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用這個詞語？
options: The scientist raised a toast to measure the temperature.
The taxi raised a toast and turned left at the bridge.
At the graduation dinner, we raised a toast to our teachers.
I raised a toast into my phone to send a photo.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：量溫度應用溫度計；raise a toast 表示敬酒。
錯誤：計程車轉彎不會用舉杯祝賀來描述。
正確：畢業餐會向老師舉杯致意，符合片語意思。
錯誤：傳照片不用 raise a toast；這個片語是祝酒。
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：畢業餐會向老師舉杯致意，符合片語意思。

vocabulary.usage: 當某人幫助你、支持你的立場時，或運氣對你有利時使用。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用這個詞語？
options: The printer was on my side because it had four buttons.
We on my side to the museum every Monday.
My teacher gave me an on my side for the test.
I was nervous about the debate, but my best friend was on my side.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：印表機有四個按鈕不代表它支持某人的立場。
錯誤：on my side 不是動詞，不能取代 go 等動詞。
錯誤：on my side 是片語，不是可數的考試用品。
正確：朋友在辯論時支持我，就是 on my side。
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：朋友在辯論時支持我，就是 on my side。

vocabulary.usage: 當對方受傷、太累或無法自行走路時，實際帶對方回家。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用這個詞語？
options: After the long hike, Dad carried his sleepy child home.
I carried the sunset home by sending it an email.
The bus carried home the idea that Tuesday is blue.
Can you carry me home the next meeting at noon?
optionExplanations: 正確：健行後把睡著的孩子抱回家，搭配自然。
錯誤：寄電子郵件不等於實際把某人抱回家。
錯誤：這個句子沒有合理的被帶回家的人，語意混亂。
錯誤：carry someone home 指帶人回家，不用來安排會議。
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：健行後把睡著的孩子抱回家，搭配自然。

vocabulary.meaning: 大放異彩；做出令人驚豔的成就
vocabulary.usage: 常用誇飾語氣形容某人表現突出、造成很大影響；不是真的放火。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用這個詞語？
options: I set the world on fire by turning down my computer screen.
The museum set the world on fire by closing five minutes early.
Please set the world on fire with this small parking ticket.
With her first album, the young musician seemed ready to set the world on fire.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：調暗螢幕不代表做出震撼世界的成就。
錯誤：提早五分鐘關門並非大放異彩的表現。
錯誤：一張停車票不適合用來表示非凡成就。
正確：形容新歌手可能一鳴驚人，是常見的比喻用法。
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：形容新歌手可能一鳴驚人，是常見的比喻用法。

audioAlignment.reviewStatus: Conservative automatic line alignment. Unmatched/overlapping background lines remain bilingual without guessed timestamps; not a full manual timing certification.

structure.title: 句型研習
structure.note: 依提供的核對版材料編排；保留原有教學範圍。

questions.meaning: 請對方給自己一點時間。
questions.usage: 需要對方暫停、讓你準備時。
questions.prompt: 情境題 1： 主持人準備好麥克風前，哪句正確？
options: Give a second me to check the sound.
Give me a second to check the sound.
Give me to a second for the sound.
Give I a second to check the sound.
optionExplanations: 雙受詞的順序不對。
give 後接 me，再接 a second，正確。
多加 to，受詞順序錯誤。
I 是主格，這裡需用 me。
questions.explanation: give 後接 me，再接 a second，正確。

questions.meaning: 表示需要做某件事。
questions.usage: 解釋任務或必要準備時。
questions.prompt: 情境題 2： 導覽員要先查看路線，應說哪句？
options: I need checking the map first.
I need to checking the map first.
I need to check the map first.
I need check the map first.
optionExplanations: need 後此處應用 to check。
to 後應接 check 原形。
need to + check 正確。
缺少 to。
questions.cue: I need to get my story straight
questions.explanation: need to + check 正確。

questions.meaning: 描述目前正在發生的動作。
questions.usage: 說明某人此刻正在做甚麼。
questions.prompt: 情境題 3： 朋友正在入口等候，哪句正確？
options: My friend waiting at the door now.
My friend is wait at the door now.
My friend be waiting at the door now.
My friend is waiting at the door now.
optionExplanations: 缺少 is。
is 後需用 waiting。
be 未依主詞變成 is。
is waiting 表示此刻正在等。
questions.explanation: is waiting 表示此刻正在等。

questions.word: 現在進行式：get + 比較級
questions.meaning: 表示程度正逐漸增加，並作比較。
questions.usage: 描述天氣、音量等變化時；原句的 high 也有俚語雙關。
questions.prompt: 情境題 4： 音樂的聲音愈來愈大，哪句正確？
options: The music gets louder that before.
The music getting louder than before.
The music is getting louder than before.
The music is getting loudest than before.
optionExplanations: 比較級後應用 than。
缺少 is。
is getting louder than 正確。
than 前不能用最高級 loudest。
questions.cue: getting higher than the Empire State
questions.explanation: is getting louder than 正確。

questions.word: 現在完成式被動：has been + p.p.
questions.meaning: 表示某事物已被做了某個動作，影響現在。
questions.usage: 描述已完成而結果仍存在的被動事件。
questions.prompt: 情境題 5： 有人已把門關上，哪句正確？
optionExplanations: has been closed 正確。
被動式需過去分詞 closed。
單數 door 用 has。
應是 been，不是 being。
questions.explanation: has been closed 正確。

questions.meaning: 指出被動動作由誰做。
questions.usage: 需要補充事件由誰完成時；原句以墨鏡代指戴墨鏡的人。
questions.prompt: 情境題 6： 誰畫了這幅畫？哪句正確？
options: The picture was painted for Mei yesterday by no one.
The picture painted by Mei yesterday.
The picture was painted by Mei yesterday.
The picture was paint by Mei yesterday.
optionExplanations: for Mei 表示受益者，不是明確由她繪畫。
缺少 was。
was painted by Mei 正確。
被動要用 painted。
questions.explanation: was painted by Mei 正確。

questions.meaning: 使用過去式表達已完成的過往事件。
questions.usage: 說明數個月前發生的事時。
questions.prompt: 情境題 7： 描述兩個月前寄出的信，哪句正確？
options: I have sent the letter two months ago.
I send the letter two months ago.
I sent the letter two months ago.
I sending the letter two months ago.
optionExplanations: 通常不用現在完成式搭配明確的 ago。
明確過去時間需 sent。
sent + ago 正確。
缺少限定動詞。
questions.cue: I know I gave it to you months ago
questions.example: gave it to you months ago
questions.explanation: sent + ago 正確。

questions.meaning: 知道某一件事；that 可以省略。
questions.usage: 陳述自己確知的消息時。
questions.prompt: 情境題 8： 你知道朋友正在準備比賽，哪句正確？
options: I know that is my friend preparing the race.
I know that my friend preparing for the race.
I know my friend to prepare for the race.
I know my friend is preparing for the race.
optionExplanations: that 後應有正常主詞與動詞。
從句缺少 is。
此處需完整子句而非 to prepare。
know 後接完整子句，省略 that 正確。
questions.cue: I know you're trying to forget
questions.explanation: know 後接完整子句，省略 that 正確。

questions.meaning: 努力嘗試達成某件事。
questions.usage: 為一個目標付出努力時。
questions.prompt: 情境題 9： 新學員試著學會游泳，哪句正確？
options: She trying to learn to swim.
She is trying to learn to swim.
She is trying learn to swim.
She is trying to learning to swim.
optionExplanations: 進行式缺少 is。
trying to learn 正確。
try 後缺少 to。
to 後不能直接用 learning。
questions.explanation: trying to learn 正確。

questions.word: 副詞 hard 修飾 try
questions.meaning: 強調為達成目標而努力。
questions.usage: 想表達自己確實很努力時。
questions.prompt: 情境題 10： 劇團努力讓演出準時開始，哪句正確？
options: We are trying hardly to start on time.
We are trying hard start on time.
We are trying hard to starting on time.
We are trying hard to start on time.
optionExplanations: hardly 表「幾乎不」，非 hard 的同義副詞。
缺少 to。
to 後需 start 原形。
try hard to start 正確。
questions.cue: I'm trying hard to take it back
questions.explanation: try hard to start 正確。

questions.word: by the time + 時間子句
questions.meaning: 指到了某個時間點。
questions.usage: 連接截止時間與另一件事；未來時間子句常用現在式。
questions.prompt: 情境題 11： 你會在店關門前回來，哪句正確？
options: I will return by the time closes the shop.
I will return by the time the shop closes.
I return by the time the shop close.
I will return by the time the shop will close.
optionExplanations: 從句語序不對。
by the time + shop closes 正確。
第三人稱單數 shop 要 closes。
未來時間子句通常不用 will close。
questions.cue: by the time the bar closes
questions.explanation: by the time + shop closes 正確。

questions.meaning: 有某種感覺或想做某事。
questions.usage: 表達想做或快要有某種狀態的感受。
questions.prompt: 情境題 12： 下雨天很想留在家，哪句正確？
options: I feel like staying home today.
I feel like to stay home today.
I feel like stayed home today.
I feel like stay home today.
optionExplanations: feel like staying 正確。
此結構不用 to stay。
不是過去式 stayed。
like 後應用 staying。
questions.explanation: feel like staying 正確。

questions.meaning: 表達未來會做的事，與上文 if 條件相連。
questions.usage: 對未來可能發生的情況作承諾。
questions.prompt: 情境題 13： 朋友若需要幫忙，你會打電話，哪句正確？
options: If you need help, I will calling you.
If you need help, I will call you.
If you will need help, I will call you.
If you need help, I calling you.
optionExplanations: will 後應接 call。
if 現在式 + will 原形，正確。
一般未來條件的 if 從句不用 will。
主句缺少 will/am。
questions.explanation: if 現在式 + will 原形，正確。

questions.word: let us / let’s + 原形動詞
questions.meaning: 提出一起做某事的建議。
questions.usage: 邀請同伴共同採取行動。
questions.prompt: 情境題 14： 提議大家為生日會佈置場地，哪句正確？
options: Let's to decorate the room together.
optionExplanations: let’s + decorate 正確。
let’s 後需原形 decorate。
不加 to。
不用過去式 decorated。
questions.cue: let's set the world on fire
questions.explanation: let’s + decorate 正確。

questions.meaning: 表示能力或可能性。
questions.usage: 談能力或提出做得到的事情。
questions.prompt: 情境題 15： 說明大家可以在圖書館借書，哪句正確？
options: We can to borrow books here.
optionExplanations: can 後需 borrow。
can borrow 正確。
情態動詞不加 s。
can 後不加 to。
questions.cue: We can burn brighter than the sun
questions.explanation: can borrow 正確。

questions.meaning: 把兩個對象的程度作比較。
questions.usage: 比較速度、亮度、聲音大小等。
questions.prompt: 情境題 16： 比較兩盞燈的亮度，哪句正確？
options: This lamp shines brighter than that one.
This lamp shines more brighter than that one.
This lamp shines bright than that one.
This lamp shines brightest than that one.
optionExplanations: shines brighter than 正確。
more brighter 重複比較級。
需用比較級 brighter。
最高級 brightest 不接 than 比較兩者。
questions.explanation: shines brighter than 正確。

questions.meaning: 描述過去曾有的想法；本歌句子跨行、停頓未完成。
questions.usage: 回憶原先的判斷時。
questions.prompt: 情境題 17： 我本以為音樂會七點開始，哪句正確？
options: I thought concert start at seven.
I thought the concert start at seven yesterday.
I thought the concert started at seven.
I thought the concert starting at seven.
optionExplanations: 缺冠詞且從句動詞形式錯。
從句的時態與表達不自然。
thought 後接完整子句，正確。
缺少 was 等限定動詞。
questions.explanation: thought 後接完整子句，正確。

questions.meaning: 提出不確定的可能性或較委婉的建議。
questions.usage: 討論未來可以嘗試的選項時。
questions.prompt: 情境題 18： 團隊可能找到新方法，哪句正確？
options: We could found a better way.
We could finding a better way.
We could to find a better way.
We could find a better way.
optionExplanations: could 後不接過去式 found。
could 後需 find。
could 後不接 to。
could find 正確。
questions.explanation: could find 正確。

questions.meaning: to-infinitive 修飾名詞，說明方法或用途。
questions.usage: 談解決問題的方法、待完成的事情。
questions.prompt: 情境題 19： 需要一個學新語言的方法，哪句正確？
options: I need a way to learn Spanish.
I need a way for learn Spanish.
I need a way learning Spanish.
I need a way to learning Spanish.
optionExplanations: a way to learn 正確。
這裡要用 to learn。
可有其他句法，但此處缺適當連接，目標結構是 to learn。
to 後用原形 learn。
questions.explanation: a way to learn 正確。

questions.meaning: 用不定詞補充說明需要哪種人。
questions.usage: 尋找某人幫忙完成特定任務時。
questions.prompt: 情境題 20： 你需要有人幫忙搬桌子，哪句正確？
options: I need someone helping me the table to move.
I need someone to moving the table.
I need someone for move the table.
I need someone to move the table.
optionExplanations: 結構不自然且詞序錯誤。
to 後應用 move。
for 後不能直接接 move 原形。
someone to move 正確。
questions.explanation: someone to move 正確。

questions.word: I have no + 名詞 + to-infinitive
questions.meaning: 表示沒有做某事的理由。
questions.usage: 解釋自己不需採取某種行動時。
questions.prompt: 情境題 21： 報告準備好了，沒有理由擔心，哪句正確？
options: I have no reason to worry now.
I have no reason worrying now.
I have no reason to worrying now.
I have no reason worry now.
optionExplanations: reason to worry 正確。
這裡需名詞後不定詞 to worry。
to 後不能用 worrying。
缺少 to。
questions.cue: I have no reason to run
questions.explanation: reason to worry 正確。

questions.meaning: 詢問未來會不會發生某事。
questions.usage: 詢問別人是否會參與將來活動。
questions.prompt: 情境題 22： 詢問同學明天是否來，哪句正確？
options: Does your friend will come tomorrow?
optionExplanations: will 後應用 come 原形。
Will + 主詞 + come 正確。
不能同時用 does 和 will 形成疑問。
一般疑問句要把 Will 前置。
questions.cue: will someone come and carry me home
questions.example: someone come and carry me home
questions.explanation: Will + 主詞 + come 正確。

questions.meaning: 邀請或描述某人過來做某件事。
questions.usage: 請朋友過來一起參加活動時。
questions.prompt: 情境題 23： 邀請朋友過來看看你的畫，哪句正確？
options: Please come and seeing my painting.
Please come and saw my painting.
Please come and to see my painting.
Please come and see my painting.
optionExplanations: and 後應接 see 原形。
saw 是過去式。
and 後不需 to。
come and see 正確。
questions.explanation: come and see 正確。

questions.meaning: 表示能夠聽見某個聲音來源。
questions.usage: 描述聽見的聲音，而非主動聆聽的動作。
questions.prompt: 情境題 24： 你在隔壁房間聽得見音樂，哪句正確？
options: I can hear to the music next door.
I can heard the music next door.
I can hear the music next door.
I can hearing the music next door.
optionExplanations: hear 在此是及物動詞，不加 to。
can 後不用 heard。
can hear + 受詞，正確。
can 後需 hear。
questions.explanation: can hear + 受詞，正確。

questions.meaning: 說明在過去的某段時間裡從未發生某事。
questions.usage: 回想未曾發生的事件時。
questions.prompt: 情境題 25： 上週邀請的嘉賓始終沒有來，哪句正確？
options: Our guest never arrive last week.
Our guest never arriving last week.
Our guest never arrived last week.
Our guest didn't never arrived last week.
optionExplanations: last week 需過去式。
缺少限定動詞。
never arrived 搭配已結束的過去時間，正確。
否定重複且 did 後不能用 arrived。
questions.explanation: never arrived 搭配已結束的過去時間，正確。

questions.meaning: 表示支持某人；歌詞將月亮擬人化。
questions.usage: 討論別人是否支持你時。
questions.prompt: 情境題 26： 比賽前朋友支持你，哪句正確？
options: My friends are in my side in the debate.
My friends are on my side in the debate.
My friends on my side in the debate.
My friends are on me side in the debate.
optionExplanations: 此義應用 on，不是 in。
are on my side 正確。
缺少 are。
my 是所有格，不是 me。
questions.cue: The moon is on my side
questions.explanation: are on my side 正確。

questions.word: have + 過去分詞的縮寫辨識
questions.meaning: 這裡的 ’s 代表 has，而不是 is。
questions.usage: 辨別現在完成式中的縮寫時。
questions.prompt: 情境題 27： 哪句和「門已經被鎖上」意思及結構相符？
optionExplanations: gate’s = gate has；been locked 正確。
被動式過去分詞應是 locked。
是正在上鎖，不是已被鎖。
缺少適當動詞形式。
questions.explanation: gate’s = gate has；been locked 正確。

questions.meaning: all 可被 that 引導的關係子句限定。
questions.usage: 說明「所擁有的一切」等範圍；原句 got 是口語表達。
questions.prompt: 情境題 28： 哪句表達「這就是我需要的一切」？
options: This is all what I need.
This is all that need I.
This is all that I need.
optionExplanations: 標準這類句型通常用 all that I need。
從句主詞、動詞語序錯誤。
缺少正確限定動詞。
all that I need 正確。
questions.explanation: all that I need 正確。

advanced.title: 進階字彙
advanced.note: 依提供的核對版材料編排；保留原有教學範圍。

questions.meaning: 疤痕；也可比喻心理留下的傷痕
questions.usage: 描述傷口痊癒後留下的痕跡；抽象用法可指長久的傷痛。
options: He has a small scar on his knee from a fall.
The rain scarred at six and stopped at seven.
I put a scar inside the box to keep it safe.
The doctor scarred my appointment for Monday.
optionExplanations: 正確：膝蓋上有跌倒留下的疤痕。
這裡應用 started（開始下雨），不是 scarred。
scar 不是可單獨裝進盒子的物品。
scar 在此不能取代 booked（預約）。
questions.explanation: 正確：膝蓋上有跌倒留下的疤痕。

questions.meaning: 座位已被占用（現在完成式被動語態）
questions.usage: 說原本可以坐的位子已經由別人坐走；一般寫作可用 My seat has been taken。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「seat's been taken」？
options: My seat has taken by my friend already.
The seat has been taking since lunchtime.
My seat was been taken before we arrived.
This seat has been taken, so let's find another.
optionExplanations: 被動語態需 has been taken，不是 has taken。
完成式被動要用過去分詞 taken，不是 taking。
was been taken 把兩種被動結構混在一起。
正確：座位已被占用，所以找別的位置。
questions.explanation: 正確：座位已被占用，所以找別的位置。

questions.meaning: 在……另一側；穿過……
questions.usage: 描述道路、房間或廣場另一端的位置，或從一邊移動到另一邊。
options: My sister arrived across at seven o’clock.
She across the room after lunch every day.
The library is across from the bank on this street.
We walked across to the rain yesterday.
optionExplanations: arrived across 不能單獨這樣表示到達。
缺少動詞；可以說 walked across the room。
正確：圖書館在銀行的對面。
across 後面的表達不自然；若說在雨中走路可說 in the rain。
questions.explanation: 正確：圖書館在銀行的對面。

questions.meaning: 忘記；不再記得
questions.usage: 談忘掉一件事或忘記去做某件事；注意 forget to do 和 forget doing 的差別。
options: Please do not forget to call me after school.
She forgot locking her bike, so it stayed unlocked.
He forgets the bus to school every morning.
I forgot to my coat before leaving home.
optionExplanations: 正確：不要忘記放學後打電話。
forgot locking 表示忘記「曾鎖過」；若沒鎖應說 forgot to lock。
這句想表達搭車時要用 takes the bus，不是 forgets。
forget to 後面要接動詞，如 bring my coat。
questions.explanation: 正確：不要忘記放學後打電話。

questions.meaning: 漏洞、缺陷；字面也可指洞
questions.usage: 歌詞用 holes 比喻道歉有問題；一般可說 holes in a plan 或 holes in an explanation。
options: My friend holed the meeting at three in the park.
Our plan has holes because the paper is blue.
There are holes of my answer because it is Monday.
The teacher found holes in our plan and asked us to fix them.
optionExplanations: hole 不能這樣取代 held a meeting。
紙張顏色不足以表示計畫有漏洞。
要說 holes in，且後半句沒有合理關聯。
正確：老師發現計畫中的漏洞，要求修改。
questions.explanation: 正確：老師發現計畫中的漏洞，要求修改。

questions.meaning: 戀人、愛人（偏親密或文學語氣）
questions.usage: 描述有浪漫關係的伴侶；日常也常用 partner、boyfriend 或 girlfriend。
options: My lover is a new chair beside the desk.
He wrote a letter to his lover on her birthday.
She lover to school by train every morning.
The singer lovered every song in the show.
optionExplanations: lover 通常指戀愛對象，不是椅子。
正確：他在愛人的生日寫了一封信。
lover 是名詞，不能替代 goes。
lover 不是這裡可當「唱歌」的動詞。
questions.explanation: 正確：他在愛人的生日寫了一封信。

questions.meaning: 更明亮的；更加耀眼的（bright 的比較級）
questions.usage: 比較兩個光源、房間或顏色的亮度；通常與 than 搭配。
options: The sun is brighter to the train today.
My sister brighter her book before bedtime.
This room is brighter than the room upstairs.
This lamp is brighter of the other one.
optionExplanations: brighter 不能用 to 引入這種比較對象。
brighter 是形容詞比較級，不是動詞。
正確：這間房間比樓上房間亮。
比較時使用 brighter than，不是 brighter of。
questions.explanation: 正確：這間房間比樓上房間亮。

questions.meaning: 跌倒；倒下
questions.usage: 描述人或物失去平衡、向下倒；歌中也可能暗示虛弱或情緒低落。
options: I falling down because my shoes are clean.
He is falling down his homework after lunch.
The old wall is falling down after the heavy rain.
The bus falling down at the station on time.
optionExplanations: 進行式缺少 am；鞋子乾淨也不構成明確的跌倒原因。
fall down 不能表示寫作業。
正確：舊牆在大雨後逐漸倒塌。
缺少 is，且要說公車準時到站應用 arrived。
questions.explanation: 正確：舊牆在大雨後逐漸倒塌。

questions.meaning: 想、以為；think 的過去式
questions.usage: 回顧先前的想法或判斷，也可以用 I thought + 完整子句。
options: I thought the shop was closed, but it was open.
The bag thought very heavy after the trip.
She thought her breakfast with a spoon.
I thought to the cinema yesterday by bus.
optionExplanations: 正確：我原以為商店關門了，結果還開著。
thought 是「認為／思考」，無法這樣表示包包重量。
吃早餐應用 ate，不是 thought。
這裡需要 went to the cinema，不能用 thought 表示移動。
questions.explanation: 正確：我原以為商店關門了，結果還開著。

questions.meaning: 理由、原因
questions.usage: 解釋為什麼做某事；常用 reason for + 名詞或 reason to + 動詞。
options: This is the reason of I missed the train.
She has a reason to her new red jacket.
I reason my breakfast every day before school.
There is no reason to hurry; we have plenty of time.
optionExplanations: 應說 the reason why I missed the train。
reason to 後要接動詞，如 to buy a jacket。
reason 是名詞或表示推理的動詞，不表示吃早餐。
正確：時間充裕，因此沒有需要趕的理由。
questions.explanation: 正確：時間充裕，因此沒有需要趕的理由。

questions.meaning: 到達；抵達（arrive 的過去式）
questions.usage: 描述人或交通工具到達某地；arrive at 小地點、arrive in 城市或國家。
options: We arrived to the station before seven.
The train arrived at the station on time.
She was arrived at home late yesterday.
My friend arrived the party with a gift.
optionExplanations: 抵達車站應用 arrived at，不是 arrived to。
正確：火車準時抵達車站。
arrive 是主動動詞，不用 was arrived；可說 She arrived home late。
arrive 通常不直接接地點作受詞，應說 arrived at the party。
questions.explanation: 正確：火車準時抵達車站。

questions.meaning: 合唱團；唱詩班
questions.usage: 形容一群人一起唱歌；可以說 sing in a choir 或 listen to a choir。
options: The choir was a ticket for the train.
Our school choir sang three songs at the concert.
She put a choir in her pocket for the trip.
I choir my homework after dinner.
optionExplanations: choir 是合唱團，不是火車票。
正確：學校合唱團在音樂會唱了三首歌。
合唱團不是能放進口袋的物品。
choir 是名詞，不表示做功課。
questions.explanation: 正確：學校合唱團在音樂會唱了三首歌。
